narrative.overview: Srijon Space looks like a working print studio that happens to rent rooms. Surfaces are uncoated paper stock — warm ivory and soft paper white rather than clinical white — structured by honest 1px rules and set in ink, never pure black. Press-red-orange is the only loud voice in the room: the color of a stamp, a booking confirmation, a "Book now" you can't miss. A fine grain overlay on dark sections gives every surface the texture of stock rather than glass. The system is editorial in its type and tactile in its controls: Space Grotesk headlines with tight tracking, small letterspaced kickers, pill buttons with a springy circular-reveal hover, and flat bordered cards that lift softly only when touched.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper palette with a single press-red accent
Space Grotesk display (tight tracking) over Inter body; script reserved for the wordmark
Flat, border-structured surfaces; soft directional shadows only on interaction
Pill controls with circular-reveal hover; 1rem-radius cards
Grain texture and giant outlined display text on dark feature sections

rules.name: The One Press Rule
rules.body: Press-red is the single accent; it appears only on actions, active states, and the rare highlighted figure. If a second screen element competes with the primary CTA for orange, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Two-Press Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk sets display, Inter sets everything else, Playwrite sets only the wordmark. No fourth font, no script accents in body content.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; 1px line borders carry all structure. Shadows answer interaction only.

dos: Do use pill shapes for every interactive control and 1rem rectangles for every container.
Do structure surfaces with 1px line borders (often at 80% opacity) instead of shadows.
Do introduce dark sections with .grain texture; alternate paper and dark bands to create depth.
Do pair every display heading with a .kicker micro-label; keep headings text-balance and body text-pretty.
Do keep the accent on actions and active booking moments — CTAs, focus, selection, status.
donts: Don't use pure black or pure white; ink is #171512, paper is #fffcf6.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or gradient text; orange is the only loud voice.
Don't shadow a resting surface; depth comes from borders and paper/dark alternation.
Don't apply positive letter-spacing to Space Grotesk headings — tracking stays negative.
Don't use the Playwrite script anywhere except the wordmark.
